Adapted by phpBB Modders.
Changes: rewritten in plain wiki text without Lua (Module:Redirect hatnote): the redirect's name, then up to two pairs of a use and its article; an empty use reads "other uses", and a missing article gives the redirect's disambiguation page; no "and" lists, selfref or category options; shown in italics instead of the hatnote style, since the wiki allows no <div>; removed the source's documentation and categories.
Example: {{Redirect|Docs}}
Example: {{Redirect|Docs|the documentation team|Documentation team}}
Example: {{Redirect|Docs||Documents}}
Example: {{Redirect|Docs|the team|Documentation team|the files|Documents}}
